title: Driver charged in alleged Newton road rage stabbing
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Crime The alleged victim told officers he was pulling out of his driveway on Brookline Street when he encountered Albeldy Pinales-Villar.

By Abby Patkin October 20, 2026 | 5:25 PM 1 minute to read A Boston driver was held on $5,000 bail Tuesday after he was accused of stabbing another man during an alleged road rage incident in Newton the day prior.
Albeldy Pinales-Villar, 28, pleaded not guilty to one count of assault and battery with a dangerous weapon on a person older than 60, court records show.
